Read `.github/skills/web-testcase-generation/SKILL.md` and the kit README.
Use the explicit `ui-brd` or `ui-only` mode and structured request generated by

This generic agent definition is optional and host-dependent; the supported
scripted path uses the installed GitHub Copilot CLI without a model override.
